decision: Do not copy the peer M3 outline-variant token into the owned Material 16 M2 divider theme. The facade exports that theme, which emits foreground.divider and calls a companion bridge mapping the owned M2 system outline through the peer override. The peer M3 divider remains reachable via legacy list; its M3 behavior and mixed-theme cascade require separate visual validation.

review_context.upstream_patch_summary: M3 divider color changes system outline to outline-variant.
review_context.installed_peer_source_observation: Installed divider/_m3-divider.scss and bundled divider styles use outline-variant.
review_context.owned_reachability: Facade exports divider theme; owned theme emits historical M2 foreground.divider tokens and calls companion bridge. The bridge maps its owned M2 system outline to the public peer divider override; its system outline is generated as translucent white/black. The patch changes peer M3 divider outline to outline-variant. Although M2 and M3 systems are distinct, actual mixed-theme cascade and coexistence are not established; retain this entry open instead of treating the peer M3 change as unreachable.
